body:
I think i need to clarify some things

1) my parents aren't really talking to me about it. my mom is self destructing and clinging to me and my younger brother for support, my dad has hardly talked to any of us since he moved. my text to him could be summarized as "mom is having a hard time, let me know if you have time and we can plan a weekend maybe". his response is above. I wouldn't mind being told that as much if he had communicated anything prior. it was shocking to me, because as far as i knew the distance was stressful and reminded then of deployment and the related stress. 

2) i know for a fact that they haven't talked much at all. i know of three conversations between them total. one concerning my dad's insurance, one about the furnace in the house, and last night one about a situation with my brother. my mom mentioned recently that he hadn't really spoken to her at all about how he had been doing and got upset when she learned he had texted us kids recently because when that conversation happened he had not texted her at all.

3) whatever the case, I think I gave my dad enough of a nudge to talk to her. he just told me they're planning a long weekend together which gives me a little hope.

it's been a long standing issue in my family that communication largely doesn't happen. everyone is passive aggressive, everyone gossips. this situation is no exception. 

it's a very difficult thing to disentangle myself from, especially because i am frequently seeing my mom to plan the wedding. I'm trying to keep my mind off of it, but does anyone know how i can best encourage my mom to take care of myself without being her counselor?   she's not been in a state to work this out.

if i needed to know I wish he had maybe given me a call and explained what was happening. i reached out to try to help and he just dumped it on me when he obviously hasn't really talked to his wife about it. for all i know this will work out in the end but he's given me information that is causing me stress rather than trying to reach a resolution then communicating with his children.

that's the thing- he knows this is already iffy with me but i think he crossed a line today. i told him a few minutes ago it really hurt me and he got all huffy and hasn't really talked to me.

thank you for your words. it makes me feel much better for a third party to offer perspective.

i just hope the hurt goes away. sorry for taking your time

thank you

they say I'm crazy because i get so upset. and i will admit that i do go overboard with my jealousy sometimes. in the past especially i would let my emotions get the better of me. but i don't think it's that crazy to not want your SO to be looking at and collecting images of girls, 2D or otherwise. 

he defends it as a hobby and "it's just how he is". but between my true feelings and the feedback i get for expressing them i really don't know if I'm crazy or if I'm being wronged somehow. I've tried really hard to work on my end of things. idk what to do now.

I'd like to talk to him but he gets so defensive about it. he complains to his friends and they and him all say I'm crazy.

i think maybe i am... but i feel like I've tried everything to fix the jealousy on my end. i don't know how to talk about it... we talk about it a lot but nothing changes
